hero.title: Nordic Guarantee
hero.subtitle: Nordic Guarantee, an international company specialized in financial guarantees and surety insurance with presence across Europe, invited us to document a corporate event held at the Hotel Miramar in Málaga.

sections.title: The Challenge
sections.description: Nordic Guarantee, an international company specialized in financial guarantees and surety insurance with presence across Europe, invited us to document a corporate event held at the Hotel Miramar in Málaga, with representatives from the United States, South Africa, and several European countries. The objective was to produce a photographic report capable of reflecting the international character of the meeting and the importance of in-person networking, as well as to create institutional material for use in internal communications, corporate website, and social media.

sections.title: The Strategy
sections.description: We approached the project from a corporate and institutional photography perspective, combining event coverage with image production aimed at reinforcing and documenting brand identity and the importance of the meeting. The focus was on capturing both the key moments of the encounter and the interaction among attendees, prioritizing a visual narrative that conveyed professionalism, closeness, and the European character of the company. Additionally, we conducted a set of institutional photographs of the team and corporate environment for use in various communication channels.

sections.title: The Result
sections.description: We delivered a high-quality image bank that allowed documenting the event and strengthening Nordic Guarantee's visual communication internationally. The material was used on its corporate website and social media, providing visual coherence to its digital presence and reinforcing its positioning as a European company specialized in financial solutions and guarantees.
